roots.title: Combinatorial Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Combinatorial Optimization; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Discrete Optimization Foundation Hierarchy
children.top_down_role: Foundational navigation for combinatorial objects, discrete encodings, linear and polyhedral representations, computational complexity, certificates, and reusable algorithmic paradigms; detailed optimization problem families and advanced approximation machinery are owned by later chapters.

children.title: Spanning Structure Family
children.top_down_role: Undirected and directed spanning structures, their optimization and packing theories, and the connectivity transformations that support them.

children.title: Static Path-Flow Foundations
children.top_down_role: Static single-commodity network representations, path and flow structure, shortest-path methods, circulation and cut theory, maximum and minimum-cost flow foundations, integral network geometry, classical structured models, and introductory flows over time.

children.title: Flow-Cut-Circulation Theory
children.top_down_role: Structural navigation for single-commodity maximum flow, cut duality, feasible circulations, exact max-flow methods, global cut structures, computational regimes, and failure boundaries; minimum-cost and multicommodity optimization remain outside this chapter.

children.title: Costed Network-Flow Model Family
children.top_down_role: Single-commodity minimum-cost circulation and transshipment, their specialized solution methods, separable convex-cost extensions, and generalized networks with gains; shortest paths, maximum flow, matching, flows over time, multicommodity flow, submodular flow, and general convex optimization remain external dependencies.

children.title: Multicommodity Routing-Design Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Fractional and integral multicommodity routing together with connectivity, activation, capacity-installation, Steiner, and prize-collecting network design; foundational single-commodity flow, general approximation theory, and generic integer-programming machinery remain external dependencies.

children.title: Matching-Factor-Join Theory
children.top_down_role: Graph matching, degree-constrained subgraphs, parity joins, and matching under preferences, organized around structural characterizations, representations, methods, certificates, variants, and tractability boundaries.

children.title: Matroid Greedy-Exchange Theory
children.top_down_role: Structural and algorithmic theory of finite matroids, their greedy and polyhedral optimization principles, major multi-matroid problem families, and boundary interfaces to broader exchange structures.

children.title: Submodular-Discrete-Convex Theory
children.top_down_role: Structural theory and optimization of submodular set functions, polymatroidal systems, submodular and polymatroidal flows, generalized submodular domains, and discrete convex function classes; general graph, matroid, convex-optimization, approximation-complexity, and economic theories remain external interfaces.

children.title: Incidence-System Optimization Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Discrete incidence-system optimization, large-column representations, and facility and coverage location models; general approximation theory, integer-programming machinery, submodular optimization, and network optimization remain external dependencies.

children.title: Selection-Packing-Cutting Problem Family
children.top_down_role: Selection, one-dimensional packing, and demand-driven stock-cutting models, with their classical representations, algorithms, approximation regimes, certificates, complexity boundaries, and decomposition relationships.

children.title: Tour-Fleet Routing Problem Family
children.top_down_role: Navigation for mandatory-tour, multiple-tour, fleet-routing, and prize-routing theory; foundational graph, polyhedral, approximation, online-optimization, arc-routing, and location-routing theory remains external.

children.title: Scheduling-Timetabling-Rostering Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Navigation for machine and project scheduling, educational and sports timetabling, personnel rostering, their structural representations, solution families, guarantees, and failure regimes.

children.title: Graph Cut-Coloring-Perfection Theory
children.top_down_role: Graph partition objectives and the interlocking optimization theory of coloring, cliques, stable sets, and vertex covers; general network-flow machinery, generic approximation theory, generic semidefinite optimization, and general graph-decomposition theory remain external dependencies.

children.title: Parameterized Exact Algorithm Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Exact algorithms for computationally hard discrete problems, parameter-sensitive tractability, structural algorithm design, preprocessing, and their conditional or unconditional limitations. General complexity theory, graph theory, approximation, integer programming, matroid optimization, and finite-model theory remain external dependencies.

children.title: Approximation Frontier Theory
children.top_down_role: Navigation for polynomial-time approximation guarantees, approximation schemes, method families, approximability classifications, hardness mechanisms, and boundaries between algorithmic and complexity-theoretic limits.

children.title: Approximation Conversion Algorithm Family
children.top_down_role: Approximation methods that convert relaxations, dual certificates, or local optimality into discrete solutions. Exact combinatorial algorithms, general convex optimization, approximation hardness, and standalone approximation schemes are owned elsewhere.

children.title: Evolving-Information Discrete Algorithm Regime Family
children.top_down_role: Discrete optimization under sequential revelation, restricted memory, sublinear access, or evolving instances, organized around computational regimes, algorithm families, certificates, tradeoffs, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Empirical Algorithm Engineering Benchmark System
children.top_down_role: Empirical design, implementation evaluation, benchmark construction, performance analysis, and reproducibility for combinatorial optimization algorithms; mathematical problem theory remains in its owning chapters.
